blocks.text: (Image from Pagasa) MANILA, Philippines — Heavy rains are expected in Metro Manila and several other parts of Luzon on Thursday afternoon due localized thunderstorms, according to the state weather bureau. The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) earlier reported in its 5 a.m. weather advisory that localized thunderstorms may bring partly cloudy to cloudy skies with isolated rains to Metro Manila and the rest of Luzon on Thursday.
